answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 46292 Country: India Title: Meaning of my Name. Question: My name is Aaquib Nazir and I have two questions regarding my name: (1) I want to know the meaning of the word "Aaquib". (2) My name is Aaquib, can I call myself as Mohammed Aaquib? An elder in tabligh Jamah asked me not to. Kindly enlighten. Answer ID: 46292 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1110/727/L=1434) Aquib means ‘followers’ etc. You may add Muhammad before Aquib. Why did the tablighi friend forbid you adding Muhammad ask the reason from him and submit the question again then in-shaAllah we shall write the reply. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
